title: Branch teller PC won't boot after overnight Windows update
text:
[IT-100] Branch teller PC won't boot after overnight Windows update
Status: closed | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Hector Salas | Assignee: Hector Salas

Teller workstation at the Main Street branch failed to boot this morning after the overnight patch cycle. It sits on a blue screen with an inaccessible boot device error and loops through automatic repair. The teller moved to the backup workstation at the next window, so member lines are moving, but we are down one cash drawer station and the receipt printer is attached to the dead PC. Please check whether the patch is the cause and whether other branch machines on the same patch ring are at risk before the next push. Reimage or swap hardware as needed.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
Pulled the machine. The SSD is throwing SMART errors, so the update was just the trigger. Swapped in a spare from the depot and reimaged with the standard teller build. Printer driver re-mapped and the drawer is working.

--- Comment by Andre Dubois ---
Thanks. Please put the failed drive in the RMA batch and check warranty status. Also confirm the other machines in that patch ring show healthy disks before the next cycle.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
Disk health check ran across the ring. All the others are clean. RMA submitted for the drive. Closing this out.

title: Spike in MemberSSO password reset failures for member service reps
text:
[IT-101] Spike in MemberSSO password reset failures for member service reps
Status: closed | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Andre Dubois | Assignee: Hector Salas

Starting this morning, several Member Services reps report that password reset emails triggered from the MemberCRM admin console are not arriving, or the reset link expires before it can be used. Paul Jensen's team logged about 14 failed attempts since opening. Members can still log in with existing credentials, but anyone locked out is being sent to the phone queue. MemberCRM depends on MemberSSO for identity, so I suspect the token expiry or the outbound mail relay. Need someone to check the MemberSSO reset token TTL and relay logs. No impact on CoreBanking or OnlineBanking sessions so far.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
Found it. The reset token TTL was dropped to 2 minutes during last night's MemberSSO config push, and the mail relay was queuing messages for about 5 minutes. Restored TTL to 30 minutes and flushed the relay queue.

--- Comment by Andre Dubois ---
Confirmed with Member Services, resets are landing within a few seconds now. Please add the TTL value to the config change checklist so it does not get overwritten again.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
Added to the checklist and set an alert on relay queue depth over 50. Closing this out.

title: ACH return R01 on payroll credit batch from Goodwin, Davis and Hill
text:
[OPS-200] ACH return R01 on payroll credit batch from Goodwin, Davis and Hill
Status: closed | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Timothy Harris | Assignee: Larry Bernard

ACHHub flagged an unauthorized-return-to-originator exception on the Monday morning receipt file. A payroll credit batch from Goodwin, Davis and Hill came back with an R01 return code tied to 671151797493. The return posted against a member share savings account and left the GL clearing line out by $1,842.50. Need to confirm whether the original credit was reversed correctly in CoreBanking, notify the originator's ODFI through the standard return process, and make sure the member is not shown a negative available balance. Also check that the nightly ShareRecon run picks up the offset.

--- Comment by Larry Bernard ---
Pulled the return detail from ACHHub. The R01 is valid, the originator reversed the batch on their side. I posted the offset to the clearing GL and the $1,842.50 variance is gone.

--- Comment by Timothy Harris ---
Thanks Larry. I confirmed the member balance in CoreBanking is correct and no overdraft fee was triggered. Notice letter went out per procedure.

--- Comment by Rita Solano ---
Good. Closing this. Please add a note to the ACH exceptions log so we can spot a repeat from this originator.

title: Payoff quote request for auto loan - member planning early payoff
text:
[LOAN-050] Payoff quote request for auto loan - member planning early payoff
Status: closed | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Kathleen Smith | Assignee: Richard Marks

Kelly Taylor called Member Services asking for a 10-day payoff quote on the auto loan tied to share savings 777649643758. The member plans to refinance elsewhere and wants the per-diem interest figure and written confirmation that there is no prepayment penalty. Please pull the payoff from LoanDesk, verify the figure against CoreBanking, and send the payoff letter with lien release instructions. The member prefers email delivery at kellyt51@outlook.com. Quote should be good through 2026-07-20.

--- Comment by Richard Marks ---
Payoff pulled from LoanDesk and tied out to CoreBanking. Per-diem is correct and there is no prepay penalty on this contract. Letter drafted, good through 7/20.

--- Comment by Kathleen Smith ---
Thanks Richard. Sent the letter to the member and confirmed receipt by phone. Closing this out.

title: Teller station PC will not boot at Main Street branch
text:
[IT-102] Teller station PC will not boot at Main Street branch
Status: closed | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Andre Dubois | Assignee: Hector Salas

Teller line PC at the Main Street branch failed to boot this morning and shows a black screen after the BIOS splash. The teller had to move to the backup station, which has no cash drawer driver installed, so cash transactions were delayed for about 40 minutes before opening. The machine is roughly five years old and was due for refresh in Q4. Please diagnose, swap the unit if needed, and confirm the teller can reach CoreBanking and the check scanner on the replacement. Member impact is limited to slower lines until it is fixed.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
Drive is throwing SMART errors and the boot sector is corrupt. Not worth reimaging. I'm swapping in a spare from the loaner pool and will rebuild from the standard teller image.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
Replacement installed, cash drawer and check scanner drivers confirmed, CoreBanking login tested by the teller. Old unit tagged for disposal after drive wipe.

--- Comment by Andre Dubois ---
Thanks Hector. Closing this out. I'll move the Q4 refresh for that branch up so the remaining units of the same vintage get replaced sooner.

title: Core banking nightly batch finished two hours late, ShareRecon waiting
text:
[IT-103] Core banking nightly batch finished two hours late, ShareRecon waiting
Status: resolved | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Amy Cole | Assignee: Andre Dubois

The CoreBanking end of day batch from last night ran about two hours past its normal window, finishing close to 4:10 AM. ShareRecon is scheduled to start after the batch posts, so the nightly share and GL reconciliation started late and its exception report was not ready by the 7:00 AM operations review. The vendor status page showed no incident. We need to find out which job step stretched, whether the delay was on the vendor hosting side or our own inbound files, and whether the ShareRecon start trigger should be made more tolerant of late completions.

--- Comment by Amy Cole ---
Job logs show the dividend accrual step took 2h 10m instead of the usual 25 minutes. Row counts look normal, so it appears to be slowness and not volume.

--- Comment by Andre Dubois ---
Opened a case with the core vendor. They acknowledged a storage maintenance task running on the hosting cluster overlapping our window. They say it is rescheduled and will not overlap again.

--- Comment by Shannon Sheppard ---
I changed the ShareRecon trigger to poll for the batch-complete flag instead of firing at a fixed time. Tested in the sandbox, and the reconciliation now waits correctly if the batch runs long.

title: Debit card dispute for duplicate merchant charge, member requests provisional credit
text:
[OPS-201] Debit card dispute for duplicate merchant charge, member requests provisional credit
Status: closed | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Rita Solano | Assignee: Timothy Harris

Ruben Smith contacted Member Services about two identical $86.40 debit card authorizations from the same merchant on the same afternoon. Only one purchase was made. The member's share savings account 377177755098 shows both items as posted. We need to open a Reg E dispute with the card network, log the claim date, and decide on provisional credit within the required timeline. Please pull the authorization records from the CardProcessor feed and confirm whether the second item is a duplicate presentment. Member can be reached at 580-358-6037.

--- Comment by Timothy Harris ---
Reviewed the CardProcessor authorization log. The two items have different auth codes but the same merchant reference, which points to a duplicate presentment. Filed the chargeback.

--- Comment by Rita Solano ---
Approve the provisional credit. Make sure the 10 business day clock is documented in the dispute file.

--- Comment by Timothy Harris ---
Provisional credit posted and the member was notified. Merchant accepted the chargeback, so the credit is now final. Closing.

title: Outbound wire repair - beneficiary account rejected by correspondent
text:
[OPS-202] Outbound wire repair - beneficiary account rejected by correspondent
Status: closed | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Timothy Harris | Assignee: Larry Bernard

Outbound domestic wire requested by Stephen Young on 7/16 was returned to our wire queue by the receiving bank with a repair code for an invalid beneficiary account. Beneficiary is Robertson, Weaver and Williams. The account on the wire request does not match what the counterparty has on file (3162333712). Funds are sitting in the wire suspense GL and the share account 8482239313 was debited for $4,850.00. Need to confirm correct instructions with the member, resubmit before the afternoon Fedwire cutoff if possible, and make sure no duplicate wire fee is charged. Member was told to expect an update today.

--- Comment by Larry Bernard ---
Called the member on +1 934 643 6648 and confirmed the account digits were transposed on the original request. Got a signed amended wire form back by email at stephen.young31@outlook.com.

--- Comment by Timothy Harris ---
Resubmitted at 2:10 PM, ahead of the cutoff. Fedwire acknowledgment received. Waived the repair fee per policy since the error was caught at intake review.

--- Comment by Rita Solano ---
Good catch. Closing this out. Please add a second-person verification on beneficiary account fields for wires over $2,500 to the intake checklist.

title: Lending desk PC freezing and blue screens at Oak Ridge branch
text:
[IT-104] Lending desk PC freezing and blue screens at Oak Ridge branch
Status: resolved | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Hector Salas | Assignee: Shannon Sheppard

The PC at the lending desk in the Oak Ridge branch has blue screened three times this week, usually while the loan officer has several LoanDesk windows open. Event logs show memory management stop errors. Loan officers are losing unsaved application notes and having to re-pull data. Need hardware diagnostics, a RAM check, and a replacement if the module is bad. Please schedule work outside appointment hours if possible, since that desk handles most walk-in auto loan requests.

--- Comment by Shannon Sheppard ---
Ran extended memory diagnostics overnight and one DIMM failed multiple passes. Ordered a replacement module and swapped it after close yesterday.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
Good catch. Please leave the ticket open through the weekend and watch for repeat crashes before closing.

--- Comment by Shannon Sheppard ---
No blue screens in the past five days, and the loan officer confirms LoanDesk is stable. Marking resolved.

title: Debit card dispute - unrecognized merchant charges on checking
text:
[OPS-203] Debit card dispute - unrecognized merchant charges on checking
Status: closed | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Rita Solano | Assignee: Timothy Harris

Member Brittany Powell reported three unrecognized online charges totaling $312.40 posted to the debit card 4303 9327 7962 9310 tied to checking 235264493804. Member still has the card in hand, so this looks like card-not-present fraud. Need to file the Reg E dispute with the network, issue provisional credit within the required window, block and reissue the card, and review the CardProcessor authorization logs for related attempts. Member prefers contact by email at bpowell92@icloud.com. Reg E clock starts 7/17.

--- Comment by Timothy Harris ---
Card blocked and replacement ordered. Pulled auth logs from CardProcessor and found two additional declined attempts from the same merchant descriptor the following morning.

--- Comment by Timothy Harris ---
Provisional credit of $312.40 posted to 235264493804 on 7/20, well inside the ten business day window. Dispute filed with the network.

--- Comment by Rita Solano ---
Network ruled in the member's favor and chargebacks are final. Closing the ticket.

title: Missing title document on auto loan collateral file
text:
[LOAN-051] Missing title document on auto loan collateral file
Status: closed | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Richard Marks | Assignee: Kathleen Smith

During the post-closing QC review of the auto loan tied to 8706113987, we found the lien perfection package has no copy of the title or the state lien filing confirmation. The loan funded through LoanDesk last week and the file is currently flagged as incomplete. Christopher Moore was told the title would arrive within 30 days from the dealer. Please contact the dealer, confirm whether the title application was submitted with Brightwater listed as first lienholder, and upload proof to the collateral file. Hold any exception reporting until we know the status.

--- Comment by Kathleen Smith ---
Called the dealer's title clerk. They submitted the application to the state and had not mailed us the confirmation. They will email a copy of the lien filing today.

--- Comment by Rita Jimenez ---
Received the lien filing confirmation and uploaded it. The title itself should follow by mail. I will leave the ticket open until the original comes in.

--- Comment by Kathleen Smith ---
Original title arrived and was scanned to the collateral file. Lien shows Brightwater as first lienholder. Closing this out.

title: Payoff quote for auto loan after refinance elsewhere
text:
[LOAN-052] Payoff quote for auto loan after refinance elsewhere
Status: closed | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Rita Jimenez | Assignee: Martin Ford

Christopher Moore called to say they are refinancing the auto loan on 8706113987 with another lender and needs a written payoff quote good through the end of next week. The new lender asked for per diem interest and wire or check instructions. The client also wants confirmation that no prepayment penalty applies. Please generate the payoff letter from CoreBanking, verify the per diem, and send it to the client at moore.christopher42@yahoo.com and directly to the new lender once we receive their written authorization.

--- Comment by Martin Ford ---
Generated the payoff letter good through 8/7 with the per diem shown. Confirmed with the note that there is no prepayment penalty on this loan.

--- Comment by Rita Jimenez ---
Thanks Martin. The client confirmed the letter arrived and the new lender sent their authorization form. Please release the quote to them.

--- Comment by Martin Ford ---
Sent to the new lender. Payoff was received on 8/4 and the loan has been closed with the lien release mailed out.

title: Structuring alert: split cash deposits on share savings
text:
[BSA-0380] Structuring alert: split cash deposits on share savings
Status: closed | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Monica Feld | Assignee: Chris Burgess

BSAWatch generated a structuring alert on 8482239313 belonging to Stephen Young. The rule flagged two cash deposits of $9,200 and $9,400 made on consecutive days at different branches, which together total $18,600 and sit just under the $10,000 CTR threshold. The client is a low-risk individual member who has been with us since 2018, and the account has had no prior alerts. Please review teller notes and the deposit history, and decide whether this needs a SAR referral or can be closed as a false positive.

--- Comment by Chris Burgess ---
Pulled the 12-month history for 8482239313. Cash activity is normally light, so the two deposits stand out. Checking teller notes and calling the client through the number in MemberCRM, 934.643.6648.

--- Comment by Chris Burgess ---
Spoke with the client. The cash came from the private sale of a used vehicle, and they split the deposits only because they were in different parts of the county on those two days. They had a signed bill of sale, and the teller note confirms they showed it. No attempt to avoid reporting, and the amounts are consistent with the sale price. Closing as a false positive.

--- Comment by Wesley Tran ---
Agreed. Please attach the bill of sale reference to the case file and add a note to the alert tuning log. We may want to widen the lookback before this rule fires on low-risk members.

title: Member services workstation intermittently losing network at downtown branch
text:
[IT-105] Member services workstation intermittently losing network at downtown branch
Status: closed | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Andre Dubois | Assignee: Hector Salas

One member services workstation at the downtown branch drops its network connection every 15 to 20 minutes, which kicks the user out of MemberCRM and forces a fresh MemberSSO login. Other desks on the same switch are fine. Suspect a bad patch cable, a failing NIC, or a faulty switch port. The representative is working from a neighboring desk for now. Please troubleshoot on site, replace parts as needed, and verify the connection holds for a full business day.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
Swapped the patch cable and moved the drop to a different switch port. Link flapping continued, so I replaced the NIC with a USB gigabit adapter as a stopgap.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
Found the wall jack punch-down was loose. Re-terminated it, removed the adapter, and the link has been solid for three days. Good to close.

title: CoreBanking end-of-day batch running 90 minutes late
text:
[IT-106] CoreBanking end-of-day batch running 90 minutes late
Status: resolved | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Amy Cole | Assignee: Hector Salas

The nightly CoreBanking posting batch finished at roughly 4:40 AM instead of the usual 3:10 AM. Downstream, ShareRecon scripts started late and the GL reconciliation report was not ready when Operations came in. ACHHub inbound files were held until posting completed, and the morning CardProcessor balance feed refreshed late. The vendor status page shows no incident. Need to determine if the delay came from our side (large file loads, ShareRecon lock contention) or from the vendor hosted environment. Please pull job timing logs for each batch step and compare with the last two weeks.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
Step timing shows the interest accrual step took 78 minutes versus a normal 20. Everything else was on baseline. Opening a case with the CoreBanking vendor to ask about index maintenance on their side.

--- Comment by Amy Cole ---
Vendor confirmed they ran a table reindex during our batch window that was not on the maintenance calendar. They moved it to Sunday afternoons going forward. Last night's batch finished at 3:05 AM.

--- Comment by Andre Dubois ---
Good. Marking resolved, and we will watch the next five runs before closing.

title: Missing title document on auto loan funded last week
text:
[LOAN-053] Missing title document on auto loan funded last week
Status: resolved | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Rita Jimenez | Assignee: Martin Ford

During post-closing QC, Rita flagged that the original title or lien-perfection evidence for Kelly Taylor's used vehicle loan is not in the loan file. The loan funded 2026-08-03 through LoanDesk. The dealer has 30 days to deliver the title package, but our checklist shows neither the title application nor a state confirmation of lien recording. Need to contact the dealer, confirm the lien filing status with the NC DMV, and update the file. Collateral exception should be logged until resolved.

--- Comment by Martin Ford ---
Called the dealer's title clerk. They had the application and mailed it to the DMV on 8/6, but never sent us the copy. They are emailing the receipt today.

--- Comment by Rita Jimenez ---
Received the receipt. Lien is recorded with Brightwater as first lienholder. I attached it to the file and cleared the collateral exception.

--- Comment by Martin Ford ---
Marking resolved. I'll ask the dealer to send the title copy at submission going forward.

title: Structuring alert: repeated sub-$10K cash deposits on share savings
text:
[BSA-0381] Structuring alert: repeated sub-$10K cash deposits on share savings
Status: closed | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Monica Feld | Assignee: Chris Burgess

BSAWatch generated a structuring alert on 7177591858 belonging to Carlos Larson (individual, member segment, risk low). Four cash deposits between $8,200 and $9,400 posted over six business days, totaling $35,600 against a 30-day baseline of roughly $1,500. Alert scenario is cash aggregation just under the CTR threshold. Please pull the deposit tickets, review the branch teller notes, and decide whether to escalate to an SAR referral or close as a false positive. Member has been with Brightwater since 2021 with no prior alerts.

--- Comment by Chris Burgess ---
Reviewed the teller notes and deposit slips. The deposits trace to proceeds from the sale of a vehicle, paid in installments by the buyer. The client brought a signed bill of sale and the installment schedule to the branch, and MemberCRM has the note. Deposit amounts match the schedule, so the pattern reflects the buyer's payment plan rather than any effort to avoid reporting.

--- Comment by Monica Feld ---
Agreed. Documentation is on file and nothing else on the account is unusual. Closing as a false positive, no SAR. I'll add a tuning note on the scenario for installment-sale deposits.

title: Card dispute: recurring subscription charged after cancellation
text:
[OPS-204] Card dispute: recurring subscription charged after cancellation
Status: resolved | Priority: P4 | Reporter: Timothy Harris | Assignee: Larry Bernard

Russell Mcneil disputes a $34.99 monthly subscription charge on the debit card that continued after a cancellation request. The member says cancellation was confirmed by email to russellm7@gmail.com in June. Two charges have posted since then to 740654430689. Because this client is rated high risk, please check for any open alerts in BSAWatch before extending provisional credit, and coordinate with Compliance if needed. Collect the cancellation proof from the member and file under the recurring billing reason code with the network.

--- Comment by Larry Bernard ---
No open BSAWatch alerts on this account, so I am clear to proceed. Waiting on the cancellation confirmation from the member.

--- Comment by Timothy Harris ---
Member sent the confirmation and I attached it to the file. Chargeback submitted under the cancelled recurring reason code for both charges.

--- Comment by Larry Bernard ---
Merchant did not respond within the network window and both items were credited back. Marking resolved, will close after the statement cycle.

title: CTR review: $12,500 cash deposit, high-risk member
text:
[BSA-0382] CTR review: $12,500 cash deposit, high-risk member
Status: closed | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Wesley Tran | Assignee: Monica Feld

Daily CTR report flagged a single cash deposit of $12,500 into checking 79234563668 for John Figueroa (individual, member segment, risk high, client since 2019). Need to confirm the CTR was filed accurately within the 15-day window, that the member identification fields were captured at the teller line, and that the activity is consistent with the profile. Because the client is rated high risk, a second-level look at the source of funds is required before we sign off on the filing.

--- Comment by Monica Feld ---
CTR filed and acknowledged by FinCEN. ID fields complete. Source of funds was documented at the window as proceeds from selling used restaurant equipment, with a receipt scanned to the file. A one-time deposit of this size fits that explanation and the account shows no layering or rapid outflow afterward. No suspicious activity. Closing.

title: Wire repair - intermediary bank rejection on international-format payment
text:
[OPS-205] Wire repair - intermediary bank rejection on international-format payment
Status: resolved | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Larry Bernard | Assignee: Timothy Harris

A $18,200.00 wire to Robertson, Weaver and Williams for Stephen Young was kicked back on 8/11 because the intermediary bank rejected the payment for missing beneficiary address detail in the originator-to-beneficiary field. Settlement beneficiary account on file is 3162333712. We need to repair the message with complete beneficiary information, reconfirm the amount with the member, and resend. Also check whether the wire template for this counterparty is missing required fields so repeat rejections are avoided.

--- Comment by Timothy Harris ---
Updated the saved counterparty template with the full beneficiary address and a purpose-of-payment line. Resent the wire this morning and the bank confirmed acceptance.

--- Comment by Larry Bernard ---
Confirmed credit with the beneficiary bank. I'll leave this in resolved until the suspense GL entry clears at month-end rec.

title: Structuring alert on outbound transfers following large inbound wire
text:
[BSA-0383] Structuring alert on outbound transfers following large inbound wire
Status: resolved | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Wesley Tran | Assignee: Monica Feld

BSAWatch raised a structuring alert on 2231920125 (Douglas Williams) on 2026-08-12. The trigger was transaction t_000554, an inbound wire of $165,395.98 received on 2026-08-10 from Robertson, Weaver and Williams, followed by several outbound transfers each under $10,000. The wire also carried a fraud score of 0.63 from the payments feed. Please triage whether the outbound pattern is deliberate threshold avoidance or ordinary payment activity, and review the origin of the wire and the stated purpose.

--- Comment by Monica Feld ---
Reviewed wire t_000554 and the follow-on transfers. The remitter is a known counterparty and the incoming wire instructions match prior activity on 2231920125. The fraud score of 0.63 came from a new-device flag on the sender side, not from anything on our end.

--- Comment by Monica Feld ---
The outbound transfers are payments to separate vendors, each tied to its own invoice, and none were routed to the same beneficiary in a way that suggests avoidance. They fit the stated business purpose. Treating this as a false positive and resolving. I'll recommend we exclude wire-funded vendor payments from this rule.

--- Comment by Wesley Tran ---
Fine with resolution. Make sure the invoice evidence is saved to the case before closing out the tuning request.

title: Intermittent core batch slowdown during ACH settlement posting
text:
[IT-107] Intermittent core batch slowdown during ACH settlement posting
Status: resolved | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Andre Dubois | Assignee: Amy Cole

For the third time this month the CoreBanking nightly batch has run long, this time about 70 minutes over. The slowest portion appears to be the ACH settlement posting step, where files received through ACHHub are applied to share accounts. Operations flagged that the morning ACH posting reports were late. ShareRecon also started late as a result. I want to see whether the pattern lines up with larger inbound ACH files, the Monday volume bump, or something on the vendor side. Please pull timing for the last six weeks and compare.

--- Comment by Amy Cole ---
Pulled six weeks of step timings. Overrun correlates with Mondays and the days after a holiday, when inbound ACH file counts are 40 to 60 percent above normal. Posting time scales roughly linearly with item count.

--- Comment by Andre Dubois ---
That fits what the vendor hinted at. I'll ask them about running ACH posting in parallel threads and whether they can bump our batch priority on heavy days.

--- Comment by Amy Cole ---
I added an alert on the posting step that fires if it passes the 45 minute mark, so Operations gets a heads-up before the morning review.

--- Comment by Andre Dubois ---
Vendor enabled the parallel posting option. Monday's run came in under the normal window. Resolving, and we'll keep watching for a few weeks.

title: Payoff request and lien release timing question
text:
[LOAN-054] Payoff request and lien release timing question
Status: resolved | Priority: P4 | Reporter: Kara Nwosu | Assignee: Richard Marks

The client Christopher Moore plans to pay off the loan on 8706113987 in full using funds from the checking account 793390775891 and is asking for an exact payoff figure as of 8/24, plus how quickly the lien release will be sent after payoff posts. Please confirm the payoff amount including accrued interest, check for any outstanding late fees, and give the client a written timeline for the release of lien. Call the client at +1 941 985 9521 if anything looks off.

--- Comment by Richard Marks ---
Payoff as of 8/24 confirmed with no late fees outstanding. Sent the figure by secure email and noted that the lien release goes out within 10 business days of payoff posting.

--- Comment by Kara Nwosu ---
Good. Please watch the posting on 8/24 and make sure the transfer from checking clears before releasing the lien.

title: Structuring alert: repeated just-under-threshold deposits on checking
text:
[BSA-0384] Structuring alert: repeated just-under-threshold deposits on checking
Status: resolved | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Monica Feld | Assignee: Chris Burgess

Alert on checking account 12259865081 for Roberto Young, a low-risk lending-segment client served by Kathleen Smith. The rule fired after three cash deposits of $8,500 each over a 10-day window. The client also holds a loan, 5072739438, so we need to see whether the deposits relate to loan payoff activity. Please triage, review the transaction detail, and contact the relationship manager if you need context on the client's income sources.

--- Comment by Chris Burgess ---
Asked Kathleen Smith for context. She says the client is a seasonal business operator who has made deposits like this at the same time of year in the past, and the pattern matches prior years on 12259865081.

--- Comment by Chris Burgess ---
Confirmed against last year's history: similar deposits of about $8,000 to $9,000 appeared in the same season, and the loan payments on 5072739438 were made from other funds. Deposit sizes are driven by the cash drawer, not by an effort to stay under reporting limits. Resolving as a false positive.

title: Core batch delay again: ShareRecon out-of-balance flags after late finish
text:
[IT-108] Core batch delay again: ShareRecon out-of-balance flags after late finish
Status: in_progress | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Andre Dubois | Assignee: Shannon Sheppard

Last night's CoreBanking batch completed late, around 3:40 AM, and ShareRecon then produced an out-of-balance flag between the share subledger and the GL that cleared itself on a rerun. It looks like the reconciliation read a partially posted state because one of its legacy scripts does not check the batch-complete flag the way the newer trigger does. Operations spent time chasing a variance that was not real. We need to find the script that still uses the old fixed start time, fix it, and confirm the batch delay itself has a separate cause.

--- Comment by Shannon Sheppard ---
Found it. The secondary GL tie-out script still starts from a cron entry at a fixed time rather than the polling trigger. I'm updating it to wait on the batch-complete flag and will test against last night's data.

--- Comment by Hector Salas ---
On the delay itself, I see heavy disk wait on the file transfer host that feeds the batch inputs. I'll check whether the staging volume is near capacity.

title: Title not received from dealer, past 30-day window
text:
[LOAN-055] Title not received from dealer, past 30-day window
Status: resolved | Priority: P2 | Reporter: Kara Nwosu | Assignee: Kathleen Smith

The dealer-delivered title for a vehicle loan to Kelly Taylor is still outstanding 30 days after funding on 2026-07-30. Our tracking shows two reminders sent to the dealer with no response. Until the title with our lien noted is in hand, the loan sits as a collateral exception and counts against the QC aging report. Please escalate to the dealer's general manager, and if needed ask the member to request a duplicate title through the state. Member contact is 931-649-8134.

--- Comment by Kathleen Smith ---
Escalated to the dealer GM this morning. He says the title was held up at their lender payoff and should arrive by end of week.

--- Comment by Kara Nwosu ---
Okay. If it is not in by Friday we go the duplicate title route and I'll loop in Compliance on the exception aging.

--- Comment by Kathleen Smith ---
Title arrived 9/3 with our lien noted. Scanned into the file and exception cleared.

title: Teller line PC at main branch will not boot after Windows update
text:
[IT-109] Teller line PC at main branch will not boot after Windows update
Status: closed | Priority: P3 | Reporter: Andre Dubois | Assignee: Hector Salas

The second teller station PC at the main branch stuck in a repair loop this morning after the overnight Windows update. Maxwell Castro reported it before opening. Teller is working off the drive-up station for now, so the lobby queue is slower. The machine has the standard teller image with the receipt printer and check scanner drivers. No local data of importance should be on it, but please confirm nothing was saved outside the profile redirect.
